method_note: At answer_site, rank route component dimensions by positive direct contribution to target-vs-source-token readout direction, then patch only the selected dimensions. This is channel/subspace budget evidence, not biological neuron proof.
strict_interpretation: If small budgets recover most of full-route strict gain, the answer-site route has sparse/channel-like support. If only all-dim patch works, the route is distributed at current block-output granularity.
title: Answer-Site Route Channel Budget
